name: Simple Age Calculator
description: A simple age calculator that calculates the difference between a given birthdate and the current date

name: Guessing Game (Pro)
description: A fun and interactive game built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, where the player has to guess a random number between 1 and 100 and the computer also makes a guess. The score of both the player and the computer is displayed at the end of each round.

name: My Babe App
description: This is my first React App, and will be aimed at advancing a love calculator model. It will however use a different and more personalized method.

name: GCK Admin Dashboard
description: This is the official project for the GCK Event, and has been uploaded just for storage sake. I got privileged to handle the front end of the GCK Dashboard, i had to save my own copy. Its an honor to be on the team

name: Flip Card Game
description: Flip Card Game is a memory-style game that challenges players to match pairs of cards with a fun and interactive user interface. The game is built using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript and is suitable for both desktop and mobile devices.

name: catchMe Game
description: CatchMe is a simple and addictive web-based game where the player controls a game piece using arrow keys to avoid obstacles and score points. The objective is to survive for as long as possible while collecting points. The game keeps track of the player's score, and the speed of the game increases as the score increases.

name: Browser Extension v1
description: This extension allows you to manage your wishlist and to-do items directly in your web browser. The extension is designed to work in popular browsers like Chrome, Firefox, and Edge.

name: FeedMe API
description: This API provides access to a collection of meals, allowing you to retrieve meals by type, search for meals by name, and even get a random meal.

name: watchMe Movie App v2
description: This is the second iteration of watchMe Movie Streaming App built with ReactJS that allows users to search for movies, view popular movies, and get movie details. It leverages the power of TheMovieDB API to handle endpoints and fetch movie data.

name: chatMe Escrow App
description: ChatMe is a comprehensive chat escrow application featuring real-time escrow based p2p trading, and funds management for secure transactions. The app includes user authentication, profile management, escrow chat functionality, and financial operations, designed to provide a seamless communication and transaction experience.

name: PharmaCheck Telegram APP
description: The project consists of a Telegram Bot Authentication System, a Prescription API Service, and a Frontend Application built using React. The project allows users to interact with the system via Telegram for authentication and provides prescription services through a web-based application.

name: QR Scan to Clock In System
description: This is a simple attempt to create a Clock In system for employees using QR Scan. The database is handled by firebase, the whole process is quite simple and straightforward.

name: Straight Edge Web3 Games
description: The vision for Straight Edge from The Sarcastic Geeks Trybe 🚀 is to onboard as many users to web3 network using the easiest onchain gaming, leveraging the web2 authentication.

name: iBukas Solar Energy
description: This project is a robust solar inverter management calculator system which will focus primarily on calculating load for a house hold and recommending the right type of system.

name: Home Let INC.
description: This project serves as a comprehensive marketplace for rental properties of various sorts. Whether you're an agent looking to list properties or someone searching for the perfect rental, this platform is designed to make the process seamless and secure.

name: flyMe Ticket and Courier Tracking
description: The primary aim of this project is to create a simple and efficient flight booking system with tracking capabilities. The system allows users to add new shipments and track them using a unique tracking number.

name: Metro Melt Precision Training
description: The Training is a centralized platform designed to give students a personalized overview of their training journey. It combines authentication, course information, and schedule visibility in one modern, interactive dashboard.

name: Nodemailer + Zoho Mail
description: This project sets up a secure mailing system using Nodemailer with Zoho Mail SMTP, integrated into a Next.js API route. It is designed to handle both single test emails and bulk promotional campaigns securely.

name: The Trybe Games
description: This is a dynamic collection of lightweight, Firebase-powered web games built for fast fun and real user interaction. Whether you're a competitive player, a casual gamer, or just here to test your reflexes, there's something here for everyone.

name: FinTech Banking System
description: This project is a web-based fintech banking platform that provides users with a complete range of modern financial services, including savings and secure transfers, investments in both stocks and cryptocurrencies, loans with flexible repayment options, virtual and physical cards for everyday use, and a trusted escrow service for safe peer-to-peer and business transactions; it replicates and enhances the full process of banking, enabling users to save, invest, borrow, spend, and transact securely all in one place.
